# @dotos/dui — Enterprise Angular 22 UI & Dynamic Theming Library (LLM Reference)

> Package Name (Public npm): `@dotos/dui` (Internal registry alias: `@dotos1/dui`)
> Version: 8.0.0 | License: MIT | Repository: https://github.com/dotos1/dui
> Angular Compatibility: ^22.0.0 (`standalone: false` NgModule exports — importable in both Standalone Components `imports: [...]` and classic `@NgModule`)
> Entry-Point Rule: Root `@dotos/dui` intentionally exports `{}` for zero barrel bloat. ALWAYS import from a secondary entry point (`@dotos/dui/<subpath>`).
> Slim Footprint: Zero heavy editors (Monaco, ProseMirror, xterm, Showdown are separated into the enterprise extension suite).

## 1. Installation & Global Setup

```bash
npm install @dotos/dui
# Peer dependencies: @angular/{animations,cdk,common,core,forms,material,platform-browser,router}@^22.0.0 rxjs@^7.8.0 lodash-es@^4.17.21 mobx@^6.0.0 moment@^2.29.1
# Optional peers: @angular/material-moment-adapter@^22.0.0, highlight.js@^11.11.1 (for @dotos/dui/ux/highlight)
```

Add platform theming in global `styles.scss`:
```scss
@use '@dotos/dui/theming/platform';
```

## 2. Canonical Code Templates (Zero-Hallucination)

### 2.1 Millisecond Runtime Theme Switching (`@dotos/dui/theme`)
```typescript
import { Component } from '@angular/core';
import { DotosConfigService, ThemeService } from '@dotos/dui/theme';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-theme-switcher',
  template: `
    <button (click)="setThemeMode('light')">Light</button>
    <button (click)="setThemeMode('dark')">Dark</button>
    <button (click)="setThemeMode('darkblue')">Industrial DarkBlue</button>
  `,
})
export class ThemeSwitcherComponent {
  constructor(
    private readonly dotosConfig: DotosConfigService,
    public readonly themeService: ThemeService
  ) {}

  setThemeMode(type: 'light' | 'dark' | 'darkblue'): void {
    this.dotosConfig.config = {
      theme: { type, primary: 'blue-500', accent: 'orange-500', warn: 'red-500' },
    };
  }
}
```

### 2.2 Dynamic Schema Form (`@dotos/dui/form`)
```typescript
import { Component } from '@angular/core';
import { FormModule } from '@dotos/dui/form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-schema-form',
  imports: [FormModule],
  template: `<dui-form [config]="formConfig"></dui-form>`,
})
export class SchemaFormComponent {
  formConfig = {
    items: [
      { xtype: 'text-field', name: 'projectName', label: 'Project Name', required: true, wrappers: ['form-field'] },
      { xtype: 'select-field', name: 'env', label: 'Environment', wrappers: ['form-field'], options: [{ label: 'Production', value: 'prod' }, { label: 'Staging', value: 'stage' }] },
    ],
  };
}
```

### 2.3 Dialogs: Alert & Confirm (`@dotos/dui/common/dialogs`)
```typescript
import { Component } from '@angular/core';
import { DialogsModule, DialogService } from '@dotos/dui/common/dialogs';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-dialog-action',
  imports: [DialogsModule],
  template: `<button (click)="confirmAction()">Execute</button>`,
})
export class DialogActionComponent {
  constructor(private readonly dialogService: DialogService) {}

  confirmAction(): void {
    this.dialogService
      .openConfirm({ title: 'Confirm', message: 'Deploy release v8.0.0?' })
      .afterClosed()
      .subscribe((ok: boolean) => {
        if (ok) {
          this.dialogService.openAlert({ title: 'Success', message: 'Deployment started.' });
        }
      });
  }
}
```

### 2.4 Virtualized Tree & Data Table (`@dotos/dui/tree`, `@dotos/dui/data/datatable`)
```typescript
import { Component } from '@angular/core';
import { TreeModule } from '@dotos/dui/tree';
import { DatatableModule } from '@dotos/dui/data/datatable';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-workbench-data',
  imports: [TreeModule, DatatableModule],
  template: `
    <tree-root style="display:block; height:240px;" [nodes]="nodes"></tree-root>
    <dui-datatable style="display:block; height:320px;" [rows]="rows" [columns]="columns"></dui-datatable>
  `,
})
export class WorkbenchDataComponent {
  nodes = [{ id: 1, name: 'Cluster-A', children: [{ id: 2, name: 'Worker-01' }] }];
  columns = [{ prop: 'host', name: 'Host' }, { prop: 'cpu', name: 'CPU (%)' }];
  rows = [{ host: 'worker-01', cpu: 42 }, { host: 'worker-02', cpu: 37 }];
}
```

### `@dotos/dui/common/search-box` (internal alias: `@dotos1/dui/common/search-box`)
- **NgModules**: `SearchBoxModule`
